captions.detailed: This 3D model features a seaside harbor bell tower. It consists of a vertical brown timber post with horizontal banding, topped by a dark grey, conical shingled cap. A brown wooden crossbeam extends from the side of the post, suspending a dark iron bell. The bell hangs from a black rectangular headstock and is designed to swing about its horizontal axis via a revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a seaside harbor bell tower with CadQuery. The model should feature a round timber support post, a conical shingled cap, and a horizontal crossbeam that supports a single iron bell. Connect the bell to the crossbeam using a revolute joint to allow it to swing along the horizontal axis.
captions.factory: The code constructs the model by first creating a vertical cylinder for the main timber post, detailed with thin decorative rings. A tiered conical shape, made of stacked cylinders/cones, forms the shingled cap at the top. A rectangular box is extruded to form the horizontal crossbeam. The bell is constructed using a hollowed-out truncated cone (cylinder with draft) and is attached to a rectangular cleat. A revolute joint is then defined at the connection point between the crossbeam and the bell's headstock to enable rotational movement.
